_note: Fixed sentences for the live 'lawn status now' chip on the web service report (GATE_REPORT_WEB_LIVE_CHIP). Web only, never the PDF, never frozen. The rain-covered line is the watering-copy.json water-in line reworded for a visit that may be days old ('today's treatment' is wrong after day one). recentHours is how many hours back a rainy hour still counts as 'rain fell N hours ago'.
rainWithinHour: Rain fell within the last hour. Wait until the lawn is dry.
rainHoursAgoOne: Rain fell 1 hour ago. Wait until the lawn is dry.
rainHoursAgo: Rain fell {n} hours ago. Wait until the lawn is dry.
wateredIn: Rain since your visit has watered the treatment in.
